description:
Brand Introduction: This is a warm greeting to our esteemed affiliates, ambassadors of our elegant brand. We feel honored to have you on board as valuable collaborators in our unique vision. At the core of our brand lies a commitment to elegance, originality, and passionate dedication. In each of our products, we reflect a distinctive aesthetic, infused with the love and attention to detail that define us.

USP (Unique Selling Point): Our Unique Selling Point lies in the fusion of incomparable elegance and authenticity in every creation. From exclusive design to the meticulous selection of the highest quality materials, we offer our customers a unique and luxurious experience. As affiliates, you are provided with the opportunity to be ambassadors of this legacy of distinction.

Payment Terms: We deeply value your contribution and wish to ensure a smooth and rewarding collaboration. Our payment terms are as follows:

  • Payments will be made every 7 days.
  • Payment method: PayPal
  • Commission rate: 20%

Other Information: We take pride in offering our affiliates a variety of exclusive resources. From high-quality images to videos that capture the unique essence of our brand, we provide you with the necessary tools to express the elegance and authenticity of our products. Moreover, we encourage you to create your own videos, utilizing your creativity to share the unique story of our brand.

We sincerely appreciate your participation in our affiliate program. We are confident that, together, we will create a successful and mutually beneficial collaboration. Welcome to our family of elegant ambassadors!
